name: Rites of the Wurm
text: For a turn she can channel spells through any warbeast of her battlegroup in her CTRL. Her spells, and animi cast by those warbeasts while in her CTRL, cost 1 less; her own spells never drop below 1.
verify: Core: castSpell and the option lists use circleSpellCost(); channel() accepts ritesChannelers(). Card (S1) and the Jan 2024 app update (S3): animi cast by her warbeasts can drop to COST 0.
